resultat: Anderson Silva bat Vitor Belfort par KO (coup de pied de face et coups de poing) à 3:25 du 1er round.
resultat_en: Anderson Silva defeats Vitor Belfort by KO (front kick and punches) at 3:25 of round 1.
contexte: Anderson Silva défend sa ceinture des moyens contre Vitor Belfort et le met KO d'un coup de pied de face, élu KO de la soirée.
contexte_en: Anderson Silva defended his middleweight title against Vitor Belfort, knocking him out with a front kick that earned Knockout of the Night.

resultats.methode: KO (coup de pied de face et coups de poing)
